title: Unified latency & error breakdown dashboard for model-route SLOs (stream vs chunked vs sync)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a single, query-backed dashboard in the Console that shows latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and error rates for every model x route combination, with explicit breakdowns for streaming (chunked), long-poll/async, and synchronous request patterns. The dashboard should support filtering by customer tier, region, and deployment type (hosted/dedicated/private) and link each datapoint to trace drilldowns that surface representative traces, KV-cache hit rates, batch sizes, and upstream node counts. We want this to be the canonical view for SREs and PMs to evaluate SLO health and to quickly identify regressions introduced by runtime changes or model swaps.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 latency and 5xx error rate for each model x route row
Separate columns for streaming (chunked), async/long-poll, and sync request types with toggle to hide/show
Time-range quick filters (1h, 6h, 24h, 7d) and comparison to baseline period
Clicking any cell opens a trace feed filtered to the same model/route/request-type and pre-applies a curated set of trace attributes
Annotations layer supports automatic display of recent deploys and runtime config changes (quantization, kernel selection)
Dashboard backed by materialized rollup metrics to keep queries < 500ms for common filters
Unit/integration tests for query correctness and a migration doc for dashboards used by SRE
Dashboard rows are exportable as CSV and each metric cell includes sample trace ID and link to the raw logs
Access control respects project-level RBAC for private deployments
tasks: Agree on canonical event schema for request_type (stream|chunked|async|sync) with API and runtime teams
Add/extend metric tags: model_name, route_name, request_type, deployment_tier, region
Implement lightweight rollup job for p50/p95/p99 and error counts per 1m window
Create dashboard layout and component prototypes in Figma (ops dashboard variant)
Hook up trace-linking: map dashboard cell -> templated query in tracing UI
Performance test common filter combos against staging telemetry datastore
Add dashboard to Console and create runbook entries for SRE/PMs
